description: When-to-buy guides for a product category or brand (for example 'Samsung TV', 'mattress' or 'Apple'): the months and sales events when prices usually drop, with a link to each guide on shopsavvy.com; set include_gift_guides for gift guides too. Pair it with product_price_history to answer 'buy now or wait?'. Free without an API key; with a key, 1 credit per guide returned (minimum 1). If no guide matches, say so; do not guess a sale date.

include_gift_guides.description: Include gift guide articles in results (default: false)
